data.summary: [worktree].local_files is not copied into a tree claim binds without W.create: the harness tree adopted via W.current (adopt_existing) and the item's recorded tree on a re-claim (lifecycle.claim rebind). The knob doc promised 'creates or adopts'. Fix needs ddflow/api/lifecycle.py (held by B-wait-wake). Found by roborev/kilo on LAN DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

copy_local_files lets an OSError from shutil.copy2 (unreadable source, ENOSPC) escape W.create; lifecycle.claim catches only GitError, so the claim dies with a traceback after the worktree exists but before worktree.created is recorded. Found by roborev/kilo on LAN DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

data.body: Found by the cross-family review of B-worktree-local-files. lifecycle.claim binds a tree in three ways; only the W.create path copies [worktree].local_files. Move the copy to one place after the tree is bound (copy_local_files never overwrites), with a regression test for adopt_existing and for the re-claim rebind. Needed lifecycle.py, held by B-wait-wake at the time.
data.title: [worktree].local_files reaches trees claim binds without W.create: the harness tree adopted via W.current and the item's recorded tree on re-claim (fixes bug B41902e229d)

roborev via kilo on the LAN DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (10.220.230.242) reviewed ddflow/B-worktree-local-files vs main (a245b69 + merge). It traced the copy logic (is_relative_to guard, tracked check, no-overwrite) as sound, verified the 125-knob README ratchet, ran the 4 tests. Two findings, both CONFIRMED by me: (medium) claim's two non-W.create binding paths in api/lifecycle.py (W.current adoption, re-claim rebind) never copy local_files although the knob doc said 'creates or adopts' -> bug B41902e229d, doc corrected in e7f3ec8, code fix filed as B-local-files-adopted-trees (lifecycle.py is held by B-wait-wake); (low) an OSError from shutil.copy2 escaped claim -> bug B3254e02e1f, failing-first regression test + fix in e7f3ec8, closed.
